---
name: Pattern proposal

title: "[pattern] "
labels: pattern-proposal
---

## Module

Which of the four modules does this belong to, and why? Say which half: 1A or 1B, 2A or 2B, 3A or 3B, 4A or 4B. The module charters under `docs/modules/` define them.

## Problem

What goes wrong without this pattern? Concrete failure, not a category.

## Position

What common practice does this reject? At least one sentence of the form "do X, not Y." A pattern with no position is a description.

## Prior art

The closest existing writing you know of — book, paper, standard, or practitioner post — even if it only partly covers the idea. "None that I know of" is an acceptable answer; an invented citation is not.

## Constraints check

- [ ] Vendor neutral (categories of tool, not products)
- [ ] No confidential material from any employer
